item.title: 0.8.1-beta.4
item.description:
First Fiaxe release, built on upstream OpenUsage [0.8.1-beta.3](https://github.com/robinebers/openusage/releases/tag/v0.8.1-beta.3).
## New providers
- **Inworld**: sign in on the Inworld Portal. Shows **Plan Credits** as a bar, your balance against the plan's monthly credit grant (`$100` on Builder), refilling on your next billing date, and the **Credits** balance under it. - **Sarvam**: sign in on Sarvam's dashboard. Shows the organisation's credit balance. - **DeepSeek**: API key. Shows the balance in the account's currency. - **Plivo**: Auth ID and Auth Token. Shows the account's cash credits.
## Changes
- **Claude long-lived tokens**: add a Claude account by pasting a token from `claude setup-token`. - **Show Amounts In**: show amounts in another currency, such as INR, at the ECB's daily rates. - **Fiaxe release & auto-updates**: dedicated bundle ID (`com.fiaxe.usage`), EdDSA-signed Sparkle update feed via `fiaxe-hq/fiaxe-usage-releases`, Fiaxe links in About / Report an Issue, and upstream PostHog telemetry disabled. - A saved sign-in this build can't read now says so instead of reporting an invalid response.
